newsitem.title: USA: American Bar Association to launch TV channel.
newsitem.headline: American Bar Association to launch TV channel.

text.p: The American Bar Association said Thursday it would participate in the development a television channel featuring law-oriented programming as part of an agreement with Data Broadcasting Corp.
The new service, to be called the Lawyers Communication Network (LCN), will be available to the ABA's 400,000 members through a satellite-based broadcasting system, the association said.
LCN will focus on delivering legal education, information, news and other related programming.
Accessing the service at home or at the office will require the purchase of an 18-inch satellite dish and other equipment, said the association.
Data Broadcasting Corp shares were unchanged at 7-1/4 in Thursday afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
